prompt:
Use case: professional fashion mannequin product photography atlas. Image1: exact garment shapes and textures reference. Image2: matching female mannequin identity, style and natural dressed garment fit. Generate ONE 3 COLUMN by 3 ROW contact sheet of NINE photographs, exactly equal rectangular cells, portrait canvas 1536x2304, every figure centered in its own cell. NO labels, no text, no borders. Each cell shows same full-body ivory resin FEMALE shop mannequin. Same neutral pose, relaxed arms down at sides, hands emerge naturally from cuffs, same camera, framing, head and foot positions. Head at5% and entire bare resin feet at93% of EACH cell leaving7% bottom margin, with no cropping. Background #f1eee7 seamless ivory studio, soft floor shadows. Figurine smooth, faceless, anatomically featureless retail display mannequin. Tailored cloth realistically wraps body with depth and natural drape.
EVERY ONE OF THE NINE MANNEQUINS WEARS THIS SAME LOWER BODY GARMENT: NO bottom garment: smooth blank resin mannequin legs, no skirt, no trousers.
EXACT UPPER BODY STATE of each cell:
Row1 col1: BARE resin upper body, no top and no jacket.
Row1 col2: IVORY sleeveless rib knit top (#e6ddc7), no jacket.
Row1 col3: MUTED OLIVE sleeveless rib knit top (#81846a), no jacket.
Row2 col1: open CAMEL blazer (#b7936a), NO top underneath; bare resin chest visible.
Row2 col2: open SLATE GREY blazer (#696966), NO top underneath; bare resin chest visible.
Row2 col3: open CAMEL blazer over IVORY sleeveless rib knit top.
Row3 col1: open SLATE GREY blazer over IVORY sleeveless rib knit top.
Row3 col2: open CAMEL blazer over OLIVE sleeveless rib knit top.
Row3 col3: open SLATE GREY blazer over OLIVE sleeveless rib knit top.
The two blazers have same notch lapels, flap pockets, wrist-length sleeves, relaxed tailored fit, differing only in colour. All cloth shows real surface texture. Sleeveless top tucks neatly into any bottom garment. All nine photos must obey the exact clothing list, do not add a shirt in the no-top blazer cells. Complete coherent photographs, no pasted flat cutouts. No bag, shoes, accessories. Uniform cell bounds, vertical/horizontal centers evenly spaced in a rigid 3x3 grid.
